subject: Request: Strategic Promo Package & Trial Extension for SolsticeGenomics
messages:
From: Lydia Shaw <lydia.shaw@solsticegenomics.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot extension + credits request — ask for exec approval

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with latency and cost story. We’ve got internal momentum, but procurement is flagging two blockers:

- Need more runway for the pilot (current 30-day window is too short for our wet-lab validation). Would like a 90-day extension.
- We’re also requesting an additional $50k in free credits to cover peak ingestion and an introductory 20% list discount for the first six months if we move to a paid plan.

I’ve attached a short summary of our use case and expected token profile (Solstice_Request_Summary.docx). Our CFO will only sign off if we can present an executive-approved concession that combines both credit and price relief.

Can Redwood provide an exec-level decision or direction on this? We’re aiming to finalize by the end of next week.

Best,
Lydia Shaw
Head of Digital Platforms
Solstice Genomics
lydia.shaw@solsticegenomics.com

I can escalate this to our commercial leadership for an executive exception. A couple of quick asks to help speed approval:

- Can you confirm expected daily token ingestion at peak vs average? (helps with credit sizing)

I’ll loop in our Deals lead and Head of Revenue Ops. If you can get the MAP over, I’ll put a provisional ask in with suggested concessions.

Proposed near-term step: 30-min sync Tue to review MAP & evaluate commitment options that would allow us to bridge credits + discount. Are you available?

Marissa / Naomi — forwarding the customer ask. TL;DR: SolsticeGenomics is asking for a combined concession: 90-day pilot extension + $50k free credits + 20% introductory discount for 6 months. They need executive confirmation to move procurement.

Quick background and rationale:
- ARR motion: Mid-market bioinformatics vendor, likely $150–250k ARR within 12 months if pilot converts.
- Technical fit: Redwood latency profiles match their inference SLA; primary not blocker.
- Timing: They aim to go to procurement next week.

What I’m asking for (clear bullets for approval):
1) Approve an exception package of up to $50k credits (one-time) applied to pilot usage.
2) Approve a 20% list discount for the first 6 months post-conversion.
3) Allow pilot extension to 90 days.
4) If we require a reduced concession, suggest fallback: $40k credits + 15% discount conditional on 12-month committed MRR.

Supporting docs attached: Solstice_Request_Summary.docx, proposed MAP (Pilot_Scoping.xlsx).

Why this is reasonable:
- Short-term cost to Redwood is offset by predictable uplift and strategic reference in genomics.
- We can lock a 12-month minimum commitment in the contract as trade-off for deeper discount.

Need: sign-off (provisional is fine) and the finance code for how to book the credit. If you want different numbers, call out quickly — Lydia needs an answer by EOW next Friday (28 May).

Thanks,
Marcus
